newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Bruton names new chairman of competition authority.
newsitem.headline: Bruton names new chairman of competition authority.

text.p: Ireland's minister for enterprise and employment Richard Bruton on Monday appointed Patrick McNutt, professor of political economy at the University of Ulster, as chairman of the competition authority.
He named Isolde Goggin, a senior manager with Ericsson Systems Expertise Ltd, and William Prasifka, a senior lawyer with William Fry solicitors, as members of the authority.
Burton also said he was appointing Patrick Massey, the current member of the authority, as director of enforcement.
"I see the appointments as crucial to the success of the competition authority which in turn is vital to our overall economic development," Bruton said in a statement.
